name: Bobo-Dioulasso
registryBasis: The official commune site publishes a city-plan page as a static image. National DGI sources document a cadastral office for Bobo-Dioulasso and cadastral-extract workflows; official government sources identify SyC@D/sif.bf as the integrated cadastre/domain procedure platform. The inspected app exposes an Angular shell and authenticated workflow routes, not an anonymous parcel feature/schema contract. No data form or parcel lookup was used.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The publicly indexed Cadastre Burkina host currently returns a default nginx page by anonymous HTTPS, and its www hostname fails standard certificate hostname verification. No TLS bypass was attempted. The official Syc@D portal returns an application shell; static client routes include authentication, geoserver and parcel-procedure APIs, but no public anonymous geometry/schema contract was established. No login or API data call was made.
scopeLimits: City-local DGI cadastre service and municipality map page are verified. The city page’s map is a raster planning/locational image; no cadastral polygon scope or coverage is inferable. The national Syc@D platform handles formal cadastre/domain procedures, but no anonymous full-polygon feed was verified.
